title: devx sdk to-dos scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - SDK docs / sample apps / tutorials
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Samantha Lee

Top priorities:
- Finish quickstart guide for JS/TS SDK (blocking): current quickstart uses older auth flow; needs update to token header examples + streaming sample.
  - TODO: add sample that shows streaming chat with function-calls and error handling (reconnect logic).
  - Link to GH example: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk-examples (PR #45).

- Sample app: 'Notes app' with embeddings + vector search (python + node)
  - Gap: python sample uses legacy embeddings API; replace with unified embeddings endpoint and show batching.
  - Action: pair with Evan to draft README and small dataset (100 notes) to demo caching / rate-limits.

- Tutorial walkthrough (tutorials/devx/getting-started)
  - Problem: tutorial assumes default model availability in hosted; need to add note about model fallbacks and dedicated/private config differences.
  - Add a short troubleshooting section: 'slow responses - check routing policy and batching settings'.

- API reference gaps:
  - streaming: examples only in curl; add Node + Python streaming snippets and mention how to handle partial tokens and aborts.
  - embeddings: add 'how to batch' snippet and cost estimation per 1k vectors.
  - rollouts: small PR to explain canary vs A/B in console - who to contact in product for wording (CC: Priya).

Notes / questions:
- Do we have a recommended max tokens for streaming chat SDK helper? (Ask Applied ML - Nora Patel?)
- Should sample app include Dedicated setup notes? Might be too much; maybe add 'Appendix: Dedicated considerations'.
- Where to put the small demo dataset? Marketplace vs repo? Marketplace requires approvals, repo simpler for now.

Quick todos (today):
- [ ] Update JS quickstart auth snippet (replace apiKey with Authorization: Bearer)
- [ ] Add streaming chat Node example (with reconnect)
- [ ] Draft embeddings batching snippet for Python
- [ ] Open PR to examples repo with notes dataset
- [ ] Ping Priya/Applied ML for token recommendations

Links + refs:
- GH PR draft: github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk-examples/pull/45
- Confluence draft: confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVX/Quickstart+rewrite
- Slack threads: #devx-sdk (thread ts=1700000000)

Notes to self: keep examples small (one-file demos), prefer realistic but tiny data, add 'cost estimate' callouts. Unresolved: final wording for Dedicated appendix - set up meeting with Product (Priya) next week.
